notes.title: New Frostpunk Game Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041469/11c603a66e9da8805034313af01e86bb566cd251.jpg[/img]

[h2]The journey so far[/h2]
While the road ahead of Frostpunk 2 is filled with [b]Free Major Content Updates, a console launch, and DLCs [/b]– and we’re extremely excited to show you in what ways our grand strategy / society survival game can still surprise you – we’ve also always wanted to continue our work on the city-builder survival experience that is Frostpunk 1. Both titles will continue to evolve side by side, offering players diverse and engaging gameplay experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/e9fbb08adc7e5451d4f6c3b8ab58577a41a9dfd6.png[/img]

[h2]Looking back into the future[/h2]
As our internal Liquid Engine, that the first game was created on, is no longer in development, we’ve been looking for other ways to further expand upon Frostpunk for years now. When working on Frostpunk 2 in Unreal Engine 5, the limitations of our own Engine became that much more apparent but it also made us realize we could finally go back to when it all began – the moment the Great Storm came over New London in 1886. 

With that in mind, we’re extremely excited to announce that [b]we’ve already started development on a new Frostpunk project[/b] – one that recreates the experience of the original game in UE. That is also why we went for [b]Frostpunk 1886[/b]. Let us know what you think about it in the comments! 

[previewyoutube=q9fw6_MvSss;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/e9fbb08adc7e5451d4f6c3b8ab58577a41a9dfd6.png[/img]

[h2]What are we aiming for?[/h2]
Our goal is to expand upon it with improved visuals, higher resolution, and all the other possibilities Unreal has to offer. Something that could be a great introduction to the world of Frostpunk for newcomers, but also a title that[b] die-hard fans of the game would love to play on repeat.[/b]

We don't want to simply recreate the first game in a new engine – it’s to build upon the original experience. That’s why we plan to implement tons of new content, new mechanics, new events, technologies, and buildings – all with the aim of creating new ways to shape your society, including [b]a completely new Purpose path in addition to the existing Faith and Order paths.[/b]

UE also gives us the opportunity to expand upon the world of the first Frostpunk with [b]completely new content in the future,[/b] such as DLCs. Additionally, something you've been requesting for years will soon be possible: [b]mod support[/b]. We know how long you’ve been requesting it, and we couldn’t be happier to finally make it happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/e9fbb08adc7e5451d4f6c3b8ab58577a41a9dfd6.png[/img]

[h2]Legacy we are proud of[/h2]
We don’t want to change the core premise of the game – the survival of the people of New London – but rather to recreate that experience with an even greater focus on the elements that made it meaningful in the first place.

While [b]respecting the legacy of Frostpunk,[/b] we’re confident the new additions will only enrich the experience for fans and newcomers alike.

Now, we don’t want to leave you hanging without something more concrete – so here it is: [b]we’re committed to releasing the game in 2027[/b]. Having games developed by us release more often than once every 5+ years is one of the ambitious changes we’ve taken upon ourselves – and this title is the first step toward making that happen.

For now, we’re leaving you with a tease (which we hope piqued your interest!) – but you can expect more info, including the game’s title, a first look at gameplay, and behind-the-scenes content, in the second half of the year as work on the game progresses.

[b]Remember. The City Must...
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/e9fbb08adc7e5451d4f6c3b8ab58577a41a9dfd6.png[/img]

notes.title: Children of Morta: Welcome to Online Co-op in the ‘Fellowship Sanctuary’ update!
notes.content:
Hello Family!

[b]The day you all have been patiently waiting for has finally come. Today Children of Morta gets its most anticipated free update - the online co-op. What’s more - everyone willing to try it can now download the game for free on Steam for a limited time.[/b]

You know it’s better to face challenges together. See this in the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JrvARwiOW0o

The heroic Bergson family began their epic journey with the launch of Children of Morta in September 2019, and the online co-op update marks the eighth and final stop on the game’s Development Roadmap. Previous  updates introduced new difficulty levels, the Family Trails mode, a new playable character, and more. In addition, the ‘Paws and Claws’ charity DLC helped raise thousands of dollars for Humane Society International. Now, the Online Co-op update is available for all players for free (note the console version is still in the works).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/71a410e3fb5b638aea139ca60f1083f69bebc56f.jpg[/img]

The introduction of an online co-op means that noble warriors from distant lands can fight side by side, and those brave enough to pick up against the Corruption can foretaste this adventure without any cost. If you’re willing to invite to a co-op session a friend who doesn’t have the game in his Steam library, then Children of Morta will be available for free to try on Steam between February 14th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET) and February 18th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET).

For those enjoying monster-slaying during the free period, Children of Morta will be significantly discounted with minus 65% for the base game, and minus 60% for the Complete Edition, containing also both paid DLC-s (Paws and Claws charity DLC/Ancient Spirits new character DLC).

Finally, the Onlice Co-op is available in both game modes - Story and Family Trials!

Best,
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

Greetings, Citizens!

We know a lot of you were waiting for this one. We know we took our sweet time with it but the wait is finally over: [b][i]Frostpunk[/i] is out now for macOS[/b] and is available on both the Mac App Store and Steam! This much-anticipated macOS version of the game is also available as [i]Frostpunk: Complete Edition[/i], which includes all three expansions.

Check out the [b]launch trailer[/b] here: 
https://youtu.be/P4sSTdwmpl0

notes.title: Frostpunk: The Board Game Launches its Kickstarter Campaign
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]New London citizens[/b].

We’re on the verge of an unknown, yet an electrifying path. The city administration seeks your aid in making another significant step for our community as [b]Glass Cannon Unplugged[/b], tailors of the tabletop experience, and 11 bit studios, makers of the original IP, are thrilled to announce that Frostpunk: The Board Game Kickstarter campaign is now live.

This adaptation, playable by up to four players, will be faithful to the original both in gameplay and the atmosphere. As leaders of the survivor’s colony, you will become Social, Health, Generator, and Resources Advisors. Frostpunk is a euro type of board game, so a well-thought-out strategy has an incomparably higher value than reliance on luck. You’ll survive only thanks to efficiently managing both the issuing demands of citizens and the infrastructure, including the iconic generator represented by a highly detailed plastic cube tower miniature.

Frostpunk’s unplugged version is designed and developed by Glass Cannon Unplugged - a team of board game industry veterans - along with the well-known independent author Adam Kwapinski. After playing several prototypes we’re sure Frostpunk is in good hands, and it will present new challenges even for the original game veterans.

We totally support Glass Cannon Unplugged in their crowdfunding quest, so we cordially invite you to visit Frostpunk: The Board Game Kickstarter campaign page to watch the board game trailer or back up the project:

notes.title: Frostpunk: On the Edge is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/ed47a0467a52d0ff601f680639ce6ec3b1e4f60a.jpg[/img]

Greeting, Citizens!

An all-new scout expedition is ready to leave the safe shelter of New London and step into the unknown. [i]On The Edge[/i] - the third expansion for [i]Frostpunk[/i] and the last chapter of the game’s Season Pass - is now available on PC! 

Watch the official [i]Frostpunk: On The Edge[/i] Launch Trailer here: https://youtu.be/UxWS0LiRcJM
 On The Edge tasks players with building a new community settled away from the city known from the base game, but one still driven by the orders from the capital. One day, when your masters’ favors start to deplete and the demands from the capital remain as firm as at the beginning, it will be time to think about your own survival.[b] Sooner or later, you will have to either act diplomatically or show your strong will since only forming an independent and sturdy union with surrounding Settlements will give you a chance to confront New London.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/1cbb93575bcd91ef6c26f441205f9b86e4aa1065.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]On The Edge - General Features List:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Be flexible or stay firm as the leader[/b] - Can you trust other communities? Should you respect their ways of survival or bend them to your will?  
[*] [b]Establish an economical union[/b] with other outposts using the Transport Depot.
[*] [b]Help develop other Settlements[/b] by fulfilling their requests.
[*] [b]Construct Safe Routes[/b] on the Frostland and exchange surplus resources for those you lack.
[*] [b]Discover 16 brand new areas of the Frostland and revisit some of the old sites[/b] - learning their fate after the Great Storm.
[*] Construct [b]3 new city structures[/b] and develop [b]7 new technologies[/b].
[*] [b]Communicate with other communities[/b] thanks to brand new UI in the Administration building.
[*] Try to survive [b]without control over the Book of Laws[/b].
[*] [b]Enable new mechanics available in the Endless Mode.[/b]
[*] Listen to 6 new music tracks composed by Piotr Musiał.
[/list]
Find a more detailed list of all the features below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/b84390d2174c2bf5dfd72efd7bacfbc0a2aad6c3.jpg[/img]

[i]“Frostpunk has been a long journey for us and for the players. Years of development and a ton of content released after the premiere, and now the final chapter comes in marking huge growth of the IP on both gameplay and narrative layers. Every expansion introduced new mechanics, twisting and enlarging the game, from the prequel story told in The Last Autumn to the after-storm events presented in the closing scenario - On The Edge. [/i]

[i]We’re 11 bit studios - the people who specialize in emotional rollercoasters and that’s Frostpunk. But if you’ve only tried the base game, get the Season Pass for a brand new ride!”[/i] says Jakub Stokalski, Project Lead and Lead Game Designer on Frostpunk.

Frostpunk: On The Edge is available right now on PC via Steam, GOG.com, and Humble Store. You can get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147010/Frostpunk_On_The_Edge/ 

[i]On The Edge[/i] was preceded by [i]The Rifts[/i], which challenged players to build a city on the map containing a group of islands with various resources, and [i]The Last Autumn[/i] focused on building an iconic Generator. All expansions are available in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11780/Frostpunk_Season_Pass/][i]Frostpunk: Season Pass[/i][/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/37a9e7935f25671a872cb9686815a5a2e99584ff.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][i]On the Edge [/i]- full list of features and changes:[/b][/h1]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] A whole[b] new scenario[/b]: On The Edge
[*] [b]A brand-new Setting in all Endless Mode[/b] variants: Settlements.
[*] [b]25 minutes of new music[/b] (6 tracks) composed by Piotr Musiał
[*] Many small additions, improvements and fixes
[/list]
[b]Major additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Settlements in Frostland[/b], each with its own unique story
[*][b] Dozens of Settlement improvements and trade opportunities[/b]
[*] [b]New Frostland mechanics[/b], e.g. building Safe Routes
[*] [b]16 brand new areas on Frostland [/b]
[*] [b]New lore[/b] added to some of the old sites
[*] [b]3 new city structures and 7 new technologies[/b]
[/list]
[b]New mechanics and features available in the On The Edge scenario:[/b]
[list]
[*] SETTLEMENTS: forge relations with other Frostland communities
[*] TRADE: exchange surplus resources for those you lack
[*] IMPROVEMENTS: help the settlements develop to gain their Favour
[*] FAVOURS: ask settlements for help when you run into problems
[*] RELATIONS: how you treat other settlements will change their attitude towards you
[*] CONSTRUCTION TEAMS: use them to build Trading Depots in Settlements and Safe Routes throughout Frostland
[*] SAFE ROUTES: build fast and safe connections with other settlements
[*] (New construction) TRANSPORT DEPOT: the heart of your logistics system, all shipments go through here
[*] (New construction) OUTPOST ADMINISTRATION: your window to the world. Use it to communicate with other Settlements
[*] (New construction) ARMY WAREHOUSE: a mysterious vault hiding vast stores of valuable resources
[/list]
[b]New mechanics in Endless Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] SETTLEMENTS: discover, befriend, and interact with other settlements
[*] NEW HAZARDS: all the more deadly when you have no friends
[*] CRISES IN SETTLEMENTS: avert them yourself or ask your friends for help
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/65363430e5d8b0272836cf1103c8e58c5a81ed99.jpg[/img]

It's been a long road for[i] Frostpunk[/i]. Road covered with snow and ice - demanding but very satisfying at the same time. However, all good things have to come to an end. The story of this particular game may be over - but it's not the last time for you and us to visit this frozen universe of [i]Frostpunk[/i]. We have already announced that both a brand-new mobile game and a board game adaptation ( [url=https://frostpunk.glasscannonunplugged.com/]check it out here[/url] ) are in the works - and[b] this is definitely not all that we've prepared for Frostpunk's future[/b]!

We hope that you've enjoyed this journey as much as we did. Thank you for being the best community - no matter if you consider yourself a Frostland explorer, ruthless captain, or a merciful leader. We do hope that you'll join us for the forthcoming adventures, too. To stay up to date with our plans, be sure to follow us on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/11bitstudios]YouTube[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/frostpunkgame]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/11bitstudios/]Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Frostpunk/]Reddit[/url]
[*] or sign to our [url=https://newsletter.11bitstudios.com/]Newsletter[/url]!
[/list]
Stay safe and warm, Citizens!
11 bit studios

notes.title: Frostpunk: On The Edge | Gameplay Reveal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/cd4ca65a7874aab4f6fb447b653928eb5ec58c97.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Citizens of New London and daring Frostland Wanderers!

With great excitement, we are happy to [b]unveil the new features awaiting players in [i]Frostpunk: On The Edge[/i].[/b] Frostpunk’s Lead Game Designer, Jakub Stokalski, will guide you through the additions in an all-new in-game developer commentary video. Watch it here: https://youtu.be/I5OyouKc-QA

[i]On The Edge[/i] revolves around themes of trust and loyalty. Assigned as the leader of a newly formed Outpost — settled near an Army Warehouse — you are kept on New London's leash and bound to transfer all your precious findings to headquarters. At the same time, you have to rely on scarce food deliveries and laws enforced by your supervisor. [b]It's a delicate balance to navigate — each decision introduces new potential risks and unknowns.[/b] But as soon as an alternate food source is discovered by your scouts, you start to think about surviving on your own...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/65363430e5d8b0272836cf1103c8e58c5a81ed99.jpg[/img]

The next finding is an even bigger breakthrough — [b]there are other Settlements out there willing to cooperate with you[/b]. Once you manage to gain their loyalty, designate trade routes between new allies, and regain control over your Book of Laws,  then perhaps you can form a strong, independent union, and shake off New London's yoke. And who knows, maybe one day the proud city will ask for your help? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/25ed365bcf19d4e08425bbc85eaedb0b6ce0e86e.jpg[/img]

Creating foundations for a new community comes with an array of difficulties. Confronting New London as well as dealing with other Settlements will test your diplomatic skills, but you can't forget that in the long run, [i]Frostpunk[/i] is all about survival. [b]What compromises are you willing to make to achieve that ultimate goal?[/b]

[h1][b]On The Edge - Features List:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Choose your truce[/b] - Can you trust other communities? Should you respect their ways of survival or bend them to your will?  
[*] [b]Establish an economical union[/b] with other outposts using the [b]Transport Depot[/b].
[*] Help develop other Settlements by fulfilling their [b]requests[/b].
[*] [b]Construct Safe Routes on the Frostland[/b] and exchange surplus resources for those you lack.
[*] Discover [b]16 brand new areas of the Frostland and revisit some of the old sites[/b] - learning their fate after the Great Storm.
[*] Communicate with other communities thanks to [b]brand new UI in the Administration building[/b].
[*] Try to [b]survive without control over the Book of Laws[/b].
[*] Enable [b]new mechanics available in the Endless Mode[/b].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/9ed7131ad8bd954e10378dff43183bb3aac073f8.jpg[/img]

[b][i]On The Edge[/i] is the third and final expansion for [i]Frostpunk[/i][/b]. It was preceded by [i]The Rifts[/i], which challenged players to build a city on the map containing a group of islands with various resources, and prequel story [i]The Last Autumn[/i] focused on building an iconic Generator. All expansions are available in Frostpunk’s Season Pass which can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11780/Frostpunk_Season_Pass/][b]HERE[/b][/url]. 

[b][i]Frostpunk: On The Edge[/i] will be available Aug. 20th, 2020[/b] on PC via Steam, GOG.com, and Humble Store. Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147010/Frostpunk_On_The_Edge/][b]add the expansion to your Steam Wishlist here[/b][/url]. 

Stay safe, stay warm,
11 bit studios

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/fc7e4bf2546ddad7ae74cb641185430e22e639ad.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors of the frozen apocalypse![/b]

The day you were striving for has finally come! The last piece of a puzzle of New London’s story falls into its place as Project TVADGYCGJR - a mysterious third expansion to 11 bit studios grim society survival sim - is revealed as [b][i]On The Edge[/i][/b]. Watch a short teaser here:
https://youtu.be/Ne4PejdG0xY

[code][i]"They say the snow is dead. But we've learnt to the contrary."[/i]
- Samuel Robinson, Frostland Scout (1887, New London).[/code]

[i][b]On The Edge[/b][/i] - the third expansion from the game’s Season Pass - is set after the vicious Great Storm. The expedition with a special assignment is sent from New London. On The Edge not only opens a brand new chapter set in the Frostpunk universe but also further enriches the core experience by pitting players against [b]new challenges and offering unique mechanics, both in the city and on the Frostland map.[/b]

A brand new, frozen board is set and the pieces are moving. What destiny lies ahead for your people? What will this mean for you, as their leader? Shape the future of humanity in a defining moment in Frostpunk's universe.

[i]"The Edge symbolizes the cross between what has been the past and what’s new to come. Although the society of New London, the city believed to be the last one on Earth, has survived, it doesn’t mean the struggle is over.[b] The people face new challenges that are catalysts to spark up divisions, new problems, and conflicts based on the fact, that people might have different points of view, different perspectives.[/b] Different outlook, so to speak. This is the Edge that you will face as the leader of the society that survived the great snowstorm of Frostpunk"[/i] - said Maciej Sułecki, the lead designer of [i]Frostpunk: On the Edge[/i].

[b]On The Edge is coming to Steam this Summer[/b] and will feature:[list]
[*][b] a brand new story scenario[/b], set after the Great Storm
[*] an array of challenges to overcome on [b]a new, desolate map[/b]
[*] [b]unique mechanics[/b] to utilize on the Frostland view
[/list]
More details will be revealed while we move closer to the expansion's release - be sure to add On The Edge to your Steam Wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147010

notes.content:
Hello Citizens of New London!

Frostpunk universe is expanding now with Season Pass. First thing for you to taste is The Rifts - mini-expansion adding a new Endless Mode map and a new constructible building – The Bridge. Bridge the rifts to access new areas and expand your city in unprecedented ways.

This is an introduction to two following expansions. Big stuff! First one will be "The Last Autumn" - the biggest expansion to Frostpunk - and as you may guess, one of the things to consider when thinking about it is that even the longest winter has its first day. notes.title: Frostpunk - MacOS, Console Edition, saves compatibility and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/2695059d2bea431a5b2f4defbe3c09690af69ff2.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Frostpunk Community!

We’ve got a lot of stuff to discuss, so without further ado, let’s get to it! In this Community Update, we’ll be discussing:
[list]
[*] MacOS version of the game
[*] Disappearing save files issue.
[*] Save files backward compatibility.
[*] The console release of the game.
[*] Upcoming Frostpunk content and 11 bit studios’ other projects. 
[/list]
[h1][b]1. MacOS version of the game.[/b][/h1]
As you know, Frostpunk for OS X was supposed to be launched in February but we decided to postpone the launch of this version due to some technical difficulties that were discovered at the very last moment. Over the past two months, we have been working hard to polish the game and while it’s not ready yet, we need to stress that, despite rumours, [b]OS X version of the game has not been canceled[/b] - it is simply undergoing development and polish that has been deemed so needed back in February.

We’re very grateful for your patience and understanding, we are also well aware of your eagerness to get your hands on the game. It’s a letdown that Frostpunk still has not been released for OS X and we sincerely apologise for the inconvenience. We just feel that releasing the game in its current state, even despite all the work we put into it thus far, would mean giving you software that does not meet the quality standards that are expected of us. We’re deeply sorry for this situation - we’ve expanded our dev team to fix this version of Frostpunk and release it as soon as possible. [b]We know that you’re expecting a release date and you have been waiting for it for quite a while - we’re doing our best to deliver the game you’re waiting for.[/b]

[h1][b]2. Disappearing save files issue.[/b][/h1]
Over the past few months, some of you have reported a serious issue with Frostpunk - you contacted us to let us know that your saves have been disappearing. Some of you experienced that after a standard shutdown of the game, for some of you it crashed and then the progress was lost.

We wanted to let you know that we’ve not taken this issue lightly and we have committed significant resources to find out what is going wrong but so far, our efforts - and it pains us to admit it - have not resulted in finding out what is wrong, at least so far, even despite the vast amount of data you have provided us with. Our QA division has been given a dose of fresh blood and we will not yield until this bug is found and dealt with. [b]We have several new leads, we’re running tests of our own, we’re gathering data and analysing it, so while some of your cities may have been lost to the cold grip of Frostpunk’s merciless soul, they are not forgotten.[/b] And they shall rise again, to battle the cold, survive the storms and thrive against all the odds.

[b]We’re extremely grateful for all your help, we cannot put into words how great it is to have a community filled with players who were ready to provide us with ConsoleOutputs, DxDiags and save files - all of this just shows how awesome you are.[/b] Thank you for your understanding and reports, fan creations and messages, we’re humbled to have you as our fans.

[h1][b]3. Save files backward compatibility (REALLY important stuff!).[/b][/h1]
We have already overwhelmed you with a lot of information - so we'll keep this one short. As we're constantly updating the game and trying to solve the disappearing saves issue - we have decided to disable save files backward compatibility. We know it sounds terrible - but worry not, it's not THAT bad.

[b]What are we actually disabling?[/b]
All saves older than those from version 1.3.3 (a.k.a. Photo Mode Update) of the game won't be compatible anymore.

[b]What does it mean?[/b]
Well, it means that they probably won't work. They might, in some cases. But in general, we can't promise that.

[b]Can I still keep my progress?[/b]
Good news! Yes, you can.[b] Just update the game to version 1.3.3, continue your playthrough and save it.[/b] All the saves made in version 1.3.3 should normally work in the future!

[b]When do we plan to do it?[/b]
It's a matter of a few weeks, probably. We'll keep you updated - [b]but please be sure to update your game to 1.3.3 and update your save files.[/b] We won't be able to bring back your lost progress when we finally introduce that change.

[h1][b]4. The console release of the game.[/b][/h1]
As you know, we’re working on the console version of Frostpunk. Our main idea here is to create a truly flawless, intuitive experience for our console community. So far, we’re making some really good progress! But you don’t have to take our word for it! Here’s a list of recent Console Edition previews:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.destructoid.com/11-bit-studios-wants-frostpunk-s-console-port-to-be-a-superior-experience-555732.phtml]11 Bit studios wants Frostpunk's console port to be a superior experience[/url] - by Destructoid.
[*] [url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2019/06/03/everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-console-edition-of-frostpunk]Everything You Need To Know About The Console Edition Of Frostpunk[/url] - by GameInformer.
[*] [url=https://techraptor.net/content/frostpunk-console-dlc-future]The Future of Frostpunk – Expansion to Consoles and DLC[/url] - by TechRaptor.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/5cb3590b999363808ade6c057689d939dffcace9.png[/img]

[h1][b]5. Upcoming Frostpunk content and 11 bit studios’ other projects.[/b][/h1]

That’s not all, though! We’re still working on more content for Frostpunk. It’s too early to tell you anything else at the moment - but expect to see Frostpunk’s first piece of DLC before the end of 2019!

Project 8, our next game, is also being worked on - but we’re even more secretive about it than about Frostpunk’s DLC. However, Robert from Eurogamer tried to get some information from Marta Fijak, Projekt 8’s Lead Designer. You can read the article yourself - [url=https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2019-06-04-whats-next-for-the-frostpunk-studio]“What's next for the Frostpunk studio”[/url] - and decide if he succeeded.

On top of that, we're [b]working very hard with Dead Mage team to release Children of Morta[/b]! For the time being, you can learn some new stuff about the game here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://techraptor.net/content/children-of-morta-preview]Children of Morta Weaves a Wonderful Narrative with Tight Combat[/url] - by TechRaptor
[*] [url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2019/06/03/children-of-morta-makes-dungeon-crawling-a-family-affair]Children Of Morta Makes Dungeon Crawling A Family Affair[/url] - by GameInformer
[/list]

And if you like what you see - be sure to add Children of Morta to your Steam Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/330020/Children_of_Morta/

That’s all the news we’ve prepared for today. See you next time!

Have a good one!
11 bit studios

notes.title: Frostpunk is making its way to Xbox One and PlayStation 4!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/e9fe7668ac6754104d8007ec9ea3d7d11068812d.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Citizens!

Our community asked and we have listened. We are very excited to confirm that [b]Frostpunk, the first of its kind in strategic gaming is officially coming to consoles[/b]. A gritty simulation of society survival in a frozen post-apocalypse, the Bafta-nominated Frostpunk was a bestseller of 2018 and multiple award winner in its genre. Frostpunk: Console Edition is a finely tuned adaptation of the PC hit that will be [b]making its way to Xbox One and PlayStation 4 later this year.[/b]

[h1][b]Watch the trailer here:[/b][/h1]
https://youtu.be/_Lu7FeOkHtw

Offering players [b]a complex strategic challenge alongside a rich narrative [/b]featuring an alternative take on the 19th-century industrial revolution, Frostpunk weaves a story of how our planet mysteriously freezes, putting an end to civilization as we know it and forcing the human race to adapt to the harsh conditions. As the leader of possibly the last civilized society on Earth, you’re going to build the city your survivors live in, discover new technologies, explore frozen wastelands and most importantly, manage and rule society to prepare it for life in an unforgiving world. Whether you’re an enlightened ruler or an iron-fisted tyrant, you’ll discover choices in this world aren’t as easy as they seem, and that holding power over people has a cost as heavy as the responsibility you feel in caring for them.

Focusing on a smooth transition to consoles, [b]great efforts are being taken to re-design the game and adjust its mechanics for the Xbox One and PlayStation 4, especially when it comes to controls.[/b] 11 bit studios still have some work to do but are close to the finish line, creating an intuitive interface allowing gameplay to feel natural even when playing with a controller. [i]“We don’t want to reveal the exact release date yet, but I can say that the game should be out in the summer,”[/i] says lead designer Kuba Stokalski.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/05e448189cdb3f17d63e218b6e1f34fdbca15454.png[/img]

[h1][b]About Frostpunk: Console Edition[/b][/h1]

Frostpunk is a society survival game where heat means life and every decision comes at a price. Presenting [b]complex strategic gameplay, demanding challenges and rich story, Frostpunk extends its unmatched survival experience to consoles[/b]. Adapted for consoles with revised controls and adjusted mechanics, Frostpunk: Console Edition allows you to fully test your tactical prowess on the frozen wastelands.

[h1][b]KEY FEATURES:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]MAINTAIN HOPE[/b]
Survival is about hope and the will to live. Your ability to spark and maintain these two in your people will be a determinant factor for success.
[*] [b]MAKE THE LAW[/b]
Society is a group of people abiding by the same rules and sharing similar beliefs. Establishing laws and customs will be a crucial factor in shaping your society.
[*] [b]WEIGH YOUR CHOICES[/b]
Will you allow child-labor? How will you treat the sick and wounded? Frostpunk challenges tactical skills while questioning your morality.
[*] [b]EXPLORE[/b]
Expeditions, while risky, can bring you valuable intel, precious supplies and grow your society’s population. There may be people out there, and their fate lies solely in your hands.
[*] [b]PLAY ENDLESSLY[/b]
Endless Mode offers new maps, game modes, mechanics, and allows you to dive into the Frostpunk experience deeper than ever before.
[/list]

Frostpunk: Console Edition[b] contains all the previous free updates from the PC version[/b], including The Fall of Winterhome scenario, additional customization options, difficulty settings, and balance tweaks. Furthermore, additional content updates are planned for the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/4bf36d07a3b41ba114ba3ffc77356c1a8fae16ce.png[/img]

[b]Don't want to miss future updates?[/b]

Be sure to follow our social media channels to stay up to date:[list]

notes.title: Frostpunk celebrates Christmas with a big tree and a free update
notes.content:
Despite the perpetual winter, Frostpunk couldn't be described as festive, but thanks to the free update, A Christmas Carol, the gloomy survival management game’s Endless mode is getting a little speck of hope in the form of a new holiday quest and a massive Christmas tree. 

It’s not a surprise that Frostpunk identifies with Dickens. Its frozen industrial city is an analogue for Victorian London, full of factories and poverty, while the themes of crappy working conditions and the poor treatment of the working class crop up in the difficult decisions you have to make when running your struggling haven. 

The update introduces a new quest in Endless mode, where survivors will approach you in the hope that you’ll preserve Christmas for the next generation by hosting a big communal meal and distributing presents. I know that if I was facing a miserable (but probably brief) life in a frozen wasteland at the end of the world, a present would cheer me right up. Unfortunately, given the era, it would probably just be a hoop. The Victorians had rubbish toys. 

It wouldn’t be Frostpunk without something to balance out the cheer, of course, so you’ll have to weigh the costs of having a party and plonking down a lovely Christmas tree with the benefit to morale. A celebration might go down well at first, but everyone will be a lot less chipper when they realise they've scoffed the last of the food. 

A Christmas Carol is free and out now.

notes.title: Frostpunk's free 'People and Automatons' update lets you name your suffering citizens
notes.content:
People and automatons go together like soft, squishy things and giant, heavy, stompy things with no empathy and poor peripheral vision. Thematically, then, "People and Automatons" seems like a very appropriate name for the new Frostpunk update that was released today, free for all players. 

Humans and machines have been coexisting unpleasantly since the game was released in April, but this update enables you to give them both a more personal touch by changing their names. Developer 11 Bit Studios said that "allows you to dive deeper into the in-game world," and more practically, to search for them based on given names—greatly simplifying the process of following specific units.   

Graphical updates to units and structures including Hunter Airships, Hunters’ Huts, Gathering Posts, Outposts and Workshops will serve a similar purpose: "From now on your city will look better than ever before and what’s more, it will be easier to find certain facilities among all the other buildings," 11 Bit said. 

The update also incorporates device-specific support for the Intel Skull Canyon NUC and Razer Chroma, and makes a small number of bug fixes and performance optimizations: The building grid has been changed to make it easier to squeeze structures into a space, for instance, and an issue that was causing the wrong icons to appear over buildings has been cleared up.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/33a8620ea841afe70ec23e5b3d239f9ab1dc2fd2.png[/img]

Hello there, Citizens!

As you already know, we were working on a [b]development road map[/b] - to give you some idea where we are heading with Frostpunk. We've received a lot of feedback from you - be it ideas, suggestions or bug reports. We tried to take everything into our consideration and then we matched it with our own concepts and intentions. It was also crucial for us to make all of those updates [b]free[/b] - because you are amazing and we love the passion that you show for Frostpunk. Without further ado: [b]what lies before you is a plan that we want to carry into execution in 2018[/b].

[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/FP_Roadmap.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/ab97861dfb1ee2a902cef82a5ddd842bb8f8671a.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click the image for full resolution)[/i]

[h1][b][u]- - - ROAD MAP DETAILS - - - [/u][/b][/h1]

As you can see - there is plenty to wait for! We're going to tell you more about each step of  the way when we get there - but for now, let us share some basic ideas about each waypoint.

[h1][b]1. Survivor - NEW MODE![/b][/h1]
[b]Survivor update is bringing a brand new challange[/b] for those of you who have mastered the surviving techniques - even on the hardest difficulty setting. This mode will unlock some new, special modifiers that should make you sweat - even though it's -120℃ out there! It's our first big update and we plan to roll it out in June!

[h1][b]2. People & Automatons - Basic Customization Options.[/b][/h1]
You asked us if we can give you some naming options for your citizens and automatons - [b]and that's exactly what we are doing[/b]. Oh, and we hope we can bring even more customization options in the future - but you gotta start somewhere, right?

[h1][b]3. The Builders - NEW SCENARIO![/b][/h1]
This is the most substantial update for 2018. [b]A brand new scenario, with its own story and challenge[/b]. We won't spoil anything at all at the moment - but let's just say you should stay excited.

[h1][b]4. Endurance - NEW GAME MODE![/b][/h1]

Let's admit it - Frostpunk looks good. And we want you to be able to capture its beauty with more precise tools. We've also prepared a special surprise for this update - but we're not spoiling that, either.

Of course - [b]that's not the end of the journey[/b]. That's just how much stuff we were able to pack into year 2018. But we have more ideas (and we bet you have some, too) to implement in upcoming year 2019...

notes.title: Frostpunk Update 1.0.1 | Fixes, updates, AlienFX
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/e12039969c0ab81153b7f6e22d4993e99c07db0f.png[/img]

Hello there, Citizens!

We're received a lot of feedback from you since Frostpunk's release. Some of it was about game's features and content updates (more on that at the end of this post) - and some was strictly about technical stuff. Our Tech Support and QA guys worked very hard to investigate, replicate and fix all the major and most common issues.

[h1][b]Here's the full list of changes and fixes:[/b][/h1][list]
[*] [b]Default display mode detection fix[/b] - we know you've experienced some issues with screen resolutions; it should be all fixed now (if it's still happening for you - we have a manual solution that you can use - described below)
[*] [b]More diagnostics tools[/b] - we've added some analytics that will help us track and fix issues in the future
[*] [b]"Bread and Games" achievement[/b] is working properly now
[*] [b]"The Union" achievement[/b] is fixed as well - it was working before - but was triggered by wrong events
[*] [b]"Iron Man (The Arks)" achievement[/b] is fixed - now it's only possible to get it during The Arks scenario
[*] [b]Memory leaks are fixed[/b] - which should improve stability and overall performance (more FPS, less crashes etc.)
[*] [b]Save game buffor memory increased[/b] - which should eliminate any issues that you had with autosaving feature
[*] [b]Fixed a bunch of crashes[/b] related to Heaters, Generator and endlog timelapse[/list]
[h1][b]Added feature: AlienFX.[/b][/h1]
Working with Alienware, we've added new feature to our game - which should brighten up Frostpunk's dark atmoshpere a bit. If you're using compatible hardware:
[*] Your keyboard's [b]backlight colours will change depending on the current temperature in your city[/b]. And let's just say: if you see some purple lights - better fire up that Generator overdrive.
[*] [b]Weather warnings[/b] - when the temperature rises or drops - your keyboard will let you know about it, pulsating with coresponding colours.
[/list]

Read more about AlienFX here:
[code]ROCCAT and Alienware have joined forces to bring you the most innovative and game-enhancing lighting system on the market, AlienFX. Two of the most trusted names in gaming with an amazing partnership, one incredible light show, and an ever-expanding portfolio of awesome ROCCAT products that it's compatible with. 

AlienFX makes in-game events for some of the most popular titles that much more thrilling and immersive, bringing gamers closer to the worlds they play in than ever before with lighting effects tied directly to the action.

More info on the official websites: [url=https://www.roccat.org/en-US/Products/Gaming-Software/AlienFX/]here[/url] and [url=https://eu.alienwarearena.com/groups/alienfx/]here[/url].[/code]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5Yl7ikpxN0nZhdPXT3/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Screen resolutions issue - manual solution.[/b][/h1]
Remember that one pesky issue that we've mentioned in "changes and fixes" section? The one about resolutions? Well, we've fixed it. However, it's not humanly possible to test it on each and every hardware configuration. So if you - for some strange reason - still encounter this problem, do not despair, we have a manual solution for you.

[b]Long story short:[/b][list] 
[*] we've added a special file to game's folder. It is called [b]"GfxConfig.ini"[/b]
[*] you can open it using Notepad - that's easy!
[*] then you can change some setting by yourself - like Quality (Low - Very High), VSync, resolution, windowed mode/fullscreen
[*] for these settings to work - [b]you have to launch the game with -gfxconfig parameter[/b] (find instructions on how to do that below)
[*] when you launch the game - you can change in-game settings as you please 
[*] however, whenever you launch the game again with -gfxconfig parameter - it will reset to settings from the GfxConfig.ini file
[*] if you remove the -gfxconfig parameter - game will launch with the settings that you've selected in-game[/list]
[b]So we suspect that most of you are going to:[/b][list]
[*] Set windowed mode with a low resolution (800x600) in GfxConfig.ini
[*] Launch the game with -gfxconfig parameter
[*] Change the settings to desired ones
[*] Quit the game
[*] Remove the -gfxconfig and launch the game without it from now on[/list]
[b]How do I add -gfxconfig parameter?[/b]

[b]The easy way:[/b]
- Right-click on Frostpunk in your Steam library;
- Click on “SET LAUNCH OPTIONS”;
- Write “ -gfxconfig” in the newly appearing window (without the inverted commas but with space before the dash character);
- Click “OK” and launch the game

[b]The hard way:[/b]
- Right-click on Frostpunk in your Steam library;
- Navigate to the “Local files” tab and click on “Browse Local Files…”;
- New explorer window with the game files will open, please find “Frostpunk.exe” in the folder;
- Create a shortcut to the application in the very same folder;
- Right-click on the newly-created shortcut, select “Properties”;
- In the “Target” line, add “ -gfxconfig” at the very end of the path (without the inverted commas but with the space before the dash character);
- Apply the changes;
- Launch the game using the newly-created and edited shortcut

---

[h1][b]What about some content updates?[/b][/h1]
We've received A LOT of good ideas from you. We've confronted them with our own vision - and thanks to that: development road map is almost ready. We are probably going to post it next week - so stay tuned to learn everything about DLCs, future patches and Frostpunk-related plans!

[h1][b]The City Must Survive![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Post-release update and a huge THANK YOU!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lz4CFb9pTKpVaVTXs1/giphy.gif[/img]

Hello, Citizens!

Frostpunk's release was a [b]HUGE thing for us[/b], as you may imagine. It is our biggest and most complex game to date - and thanks to your amazing support - it may be our biggest success as well! The feedback we've received from you, from gaming press and influencers - has been truly amazing (and very useful!). We can't thank you enough - you are absolutely awesome! 

We are receiving a lot of questions, too - about the game and our post-release development plans. We will try to answer some of them right now - so you are up to date with our agenda.

[h1][b][u] - - - QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS - - -[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]1. I've already finished the game! Do you plan to add more content?[/b][/h1]
It's a great question! And the simplest answer is: [b]YES, we do plan to add more content[/b]. More complicated answer is: we have A LOT of ideas ourselves and we also listen to our community (that's you!). We plan to polish some rough edges of the original game - you're reporting some issues with difficulty balance, with minor bugs and such. We want to fix that! We also plan to add more modes and scenarios to the game. What are they going to be exactly? It's too early to announce - but you should be excited. And yes - a sandbox/endless mode is on our mind as well. Frostpunk is going to grow - all you have to do right now is to wait a little bit. We do plan to release a roadmap for our development plans as soon as we're ready. Stay tuned!

[h1][b]2. I have an idea that you should implement into the game! Do it, now, please![/b][/h1]
Yup, we are aware that you have A LOT of cool ideas! Please do post them on forums or social media - we love to hear your thoughts. However, remember that we also have our ideas and our plans - so we can't promise that your particular idea can be implemented in any way in Frostpunk. We also love to read your different theories about the game's lore - so feel free to discuss them on our forums! 

[h1][b]3. My game won't launch/I've encountered a bug. What can I do? Who can help me out?[/b][/h1]
Releasing a complex game like Frostpunk is not an easy process. We consider ouselves to be premium indie/double AA - which means we don't have 300 people in QA department. However, we are totally aware that some issues are still occuring. We are gathering data from your playthroughs, from your console output files and such. This helps us to investigate the issues - so we are very grateful for your feedback! Our programmers are working on patches as we speak. We don't want to count on any half-measures - fixes that get rid of one problem, creating another. That's why we have to test our solutions out before we are 100% sure that we can release them. In the meantime, we have prepared a robust Support Guide for you. It's filled with useful tips and tricks that should fix your game. It's a temporary fix - far from a perfect one - but we are doing what we can. However, we have discovered that solutions provided in our guide tend to solve most of the issues that are currently occuring in Frostpunk.

> > > [b]You can (and you should!) access the Support Guide[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/323190/discussions/0/3211505894148951485/][b]HERE[/b][/url]!

[h1][b]4. I need to be up to date with all the news! How can I do that?[/b][/h1]
It's great to hear that you want to be part of our post-apocalyptic community! Feel free to follow us on:
[*][url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/frostpunkgame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/]Official website[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/CukfhBG]Fan Frostpunk Discord Server[/url][/list]
[h1][b]5. How do you feel about the release in general? Are you happy with the results?[/b][/h1]
Let us answer with [url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame/status/989837781185818624]this tweet[/url]. :)

[h1][b]- - -[/b][/h1]

Thank you buying the game and for your constant, amazing support! Remember that we are here, we are reading your feedback - even if we can't reply to each one of you. 

Have a good one!

notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/SFKLHqcKVSROKu19Hh/giphy.gif[/img]

Welcome, Citizens!

The time has come to tell you a little bit about Frostpunk's [b]ADDITIONAL SCENARIOS[/b]! Some of you may already know that on top of the main campaign, which you could already see on multiple [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Frostpunk/clips]Twitch streams[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=frostpunk+let%27s+play]YouTube let’s plays[/url], full version of Frostpunk offers [b]two more robust scenarios[/b].

Both of them adding [b]different perspectives on society survival, introducing new challenges to tackle and extending your overall experience[/b]. In both scenarios you’re gonna have to come up with smart ways of planning and building your city, adjusting strategy to [b]differently shaped maps surrounded by new sites to discover[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/83d8fa8d974256164134b882b58ca4c4e64b352c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]SCENARIO #1: THE ARKS[/u][/b][/h1]
[i]‘We've been chosen to safeguard a priceless treasure – the seeds and seedlings of plants from all over the world. They've been deposited in Seedling Arks to stop them from freezing, but it falls to us to build a city to protect these precious buildings until the winter ends, however long that may be. The only way to do this is with automatons. We'll ensure the green earth is reborn – even if we aren't there to witness it.’[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/46zrafRtrqMf1w7ck5/giphy.gif[/img]
‘The Arks’ leaves you with [b]very limited population[/b], pushing you onto the path of technological advancement, where [b]automatons become vital for the city’s survival[/b].

[h1][b][u]SCENARIO #2: REFUGEES[/u][/b][/h1]
[i]‘We were condemned to die with the rest of the common folk when London was destroyed. But we rose up. We commandeered the ships that were meant to carry the wealthy to safety and sailed north. Here we found a Generator and claimed it for ourselves. Now we must gather all our people in this new city before the lords arrive to rob us of our freedom again.’[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/bZEYjfMzbXnL4J6dkv/giphy.gif[/img]
If the ultimate winter was not enough, in ‘Refugees’ scenario you have to deal with [b]social stratification & unrest in rapidly growing society[/b]. 

[h1][b][u]--- RELEASE DETAILS & EXTRA INFO ---[/u][/b][/h1]
Frostpunk releases on [b]24.04.2018 (4/24/2018) 
at 3:00 PM CEST / 6 AM PDT[/b].

You can add it to your Wishlist here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/323190/Frostpunk/

Additionally, release of Frostpunk is not the end of our journey with the game. Be aware [b]that free content updates are planned[/b]. For details and new announcements stay with us here or follow on:[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/frostpunkgame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/]Official website[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/CukfhBG]Fan Frostpunk Discord Server[/url][/list]
Also, be sure to check out previous updates:[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/323190/announcements/detail/1655505702402119539]The Cogs of Progress[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/323190/discussions/0/1696040635902826494/]Irreversible - Path of Order[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/323190/announcements/detail/1655505702402119539]Path of Faith[/url][/list]
And if you want to learn EVEN MORE about the game - we have just released "11 facts about Frostpunk" - a feature preview video. You can watch it here:
https://youtu.be/1VEKpJBX8V4 
[h1][b]THE CITY MUST SURVIVE![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Path of Faith | Developer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8vF5aX9GdM6Jr04EFn/giphy.gif[/img]

[code][h1][i]“The function of prayer is not to influence God, but rather to change the nature of the one who prays.”[/i][/h1] 
― [b]Søren Kierkegaard[/b][/code]

Hello there, Citizens!

Pfew! Crazy times! [b]We are getting ready to release the game on 24.04.2018[/b] - but we still want to show you some new stuff. If you’re watching [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Frostpunk]Twitch[/url] - you’ve probably already seen the second path that you can choose in Frostpunk, besides the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/323190/announcements/detail/1651004639631306532]Path of Order[/url]. However, for those of you who prefer to avoid major feature spoilers ('cause streamers  tend to show you the whole thing) - we prepared a brief presentantion of some basic laws that you can establish if you choose the path of the true devotion!

[code][h1][i]“There's a saying "There are no atheists in foxholes" and we felt it rang true for the situation depicted in the game. But Frostpunk is about the extremes people go to to survive and we asked ourselves how it could impact the need for faith people would naturally develop. A cynical leader might twist it to control and brainwash, supplanting the idea of a higher power with cynical will of man. We wanted to ask the players whether they are comfortable with that, if it meant greater chances of survival.”[/i][/h1]
[b] ― Marta Fijak[/b], Senior Game Designer[/code]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/6e3fdde0581e1db1bb04c98982ec1c1e2bc68a2d.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/F7.jpg][i]Click here for full size[/i][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/319ae58e60386cac0fb97f7484d04ea42260d095.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/FW3.jpg][i]Click here for full size[/i][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/a74042f0f619568dffa5d495c0510612e6a9912d.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/F1.jpg][i]Click here for full size[/i][/url]

[h1][b][u] --- GAMEPLAY DETAILS ---[/u][/b][/h1]
Choosing the Path of Faith means showing your society a brand new way of life. However - for you as their leader - it means unlocking new instruments to influence the shape of the city itself. Discover new buildings and abilities as you make your first steps on the Path of Faith. Here are some examples:

[b][u]Law: House of Prayer[/u][/b]
A small place of worship for our people. Prayers, sermons and small ceremonies are held here. People living near Houses of Prayer will be more hopeful.

This law will unlock [b]a new building: House of Prayer[/b], where people can practice their faith in peace. It also unlocks [b]new ability: Sermon[/b]. When you use this ability, people living nearby will gather to pray, which will raise their hope.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PMzV7Z1tNp76rvDjoe/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][u]Law: Shrines[/u][/b]
A small shrine where passers-by can pray and put their trust in faith, gaining hope. People nearby, reminded of why they toil, work more efficiently. 

This law adds [b]a new building: Shrine[/b], and a new [b]passive effect[/b]: shrines will raise the spirits of people in nearby workplaces, so they work more efficiently and are more hopeful.

[b][u]Law: House of Healing[/u][/b]
A hospital run by the faithful. Heals the sick and the gravely ill slightly slower than an Infirmary, but doesn't require engineers. Slightly raises patients' hope.

This law will unlock [b]new building: House of Healing[/b]. It doesn't require engineers, treats the gravely ill and gives all patients a small hope bonus.

[b][u]Law: Field Kitchens[/u][/b]
Each Field Kitchen will provide people working nearby with hot meals to keep them warm.

After establishing this law you will gain access to another [b]building called Field Kitchen[/b]. Any workplaces in range will get a bonus to their heating thanks to the warm meals served in this building.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5lifVyv0eM8d2rkxOM/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][u]Law: The Temple[/u][/b]
The symbol of our devotion and our central place of worship. It brings peace to the faithful and inspires hope throughout the city. It may cause some doubters to mend their ways. 

This law unlock a [b]new building: The Temple[/b]. It will kindle hope in the hearts of the faithful and sway the doubtful. It also gives you a [b]new ability: Ceremonial Service[/b] - that raises hope and comforts the discontented. There can only be one temple in the city.

[b][u]Law: Evening Prayers [/u][/b]
We shall meet and pray together to warm not only our bodies, but also our souls.

This law unlocks [b]new ability: Evening Prayers[/b] - each use raises hope and lowers discontent.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TIyWIXgADMnmsC3QMg/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b][u] --- ADDITIONAL Q&A ---[/u][/b][/h1]
[b]1. When exactly does it release on Steam?[/b]
Game releases on [b]24.04.2018 (4/24/2018) at 3:00 PM CEST / 6 AM PDT[/b].

[b]2. I've heard there was na AMA on the Fan [url=https://discord.gg/CukfhBG]Discord Server[/url]! Can I see it anywhere?[/b]
We didn't have time to archive it, yet - but you can read the summary on [url=https://survivethis.news/en/frostpunk-ama-with-the-developers/]Survive This website[/url]!

[b]3. Where can I find the previous updates?[/b]
They are available on Steam, same as this one:[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/323190/announcements/detail/1655505702402119539]The Cogs of Progress[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/323190/discussions/0/1696040635902826494/]Irreversible - Path of Order[/url][/list]
[b]4. I can't wait to play the game! What can I do about it?![/b]
The best solution is to add Frostpunk to your Steam Wishlist and wait for its release on 24.04.2018:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/323190/Frostpunk/
[b]5. I want to learn more about the game! How can I do that?[/b]
Perfect timing! We have just released "11 facts about Frostpunk" - a feature preview video about our game. You can watch it here:
https://youtu.be/1VEKpJBX8V4 
[h1][b]THE CITY MUST SURVIVE![/b][/h1]

notes.content:

Hi there!

We don't want to tease you anymore than we already have - so without further ado, here's the:[h1] Frostpunk's [b]Official Release Date Trailer[/b] - "Serenity":[/h1]
https://youtu.be/YPCgltNJoHI
[b]Grzegorz Miechowski[/b], managing director at 11 bit studios says: [i]“We wanted to make it before end of Q1, but we ended up slightly moving the release further. The reason is simple - we needed this time for the final polishing required to deliver a game that, we believe, is the best 11 bit studios title so far. For us, production value is always the most important thing and a bug-free, carefully-balanced game is crucial to offer gamers the experience we want them to have. This War of Mine was a unique game about moral choices, and with Frostpunk, we are bringing this to a whole new level. It’s true that it took us some time to get here, but I’m happy to say that it was worth it!”[/i] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/bdde49432cce885e87cb735da8d23499edd4b166.jpg[/img]
Coming to Steam, GOG.com, and Humble Store at launch, Frostpunk will land on [b]PCs in a digital version for the price of $29.99 USD and retail version for the suggested price of $34.99 USD[/b] in the form of a special “Victorian Edition”. This special edition includes the “New London - The Art of Frostpunk” hardcover book which shows off the beautifully crafted artwork and concept images from Frostpunk’s icy interior.

notes.title: IRREVERSIBLE | Developer Update (Endgame + price reveal!)
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/4H95oLBQnL4lbDHUW2/giphy.gif[/img]

[code][h1][i]Since it is difficult to join them together, it is safer to be feared than to be loved when one of the two must be lacking.[/i]
- Niccolò Machiavelli[/h1][/code]

Hello everyone!

Last time we have introduced the automatons with [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/323190/announcements/detail/1655505702402119539]The Cogs of Progress Update[/url][/b] - this time let’s talk about something even bigger: [b]advanced endgame mechanics[/b]. It’s something we’ve kept secret for a long time - even though you tried really hard to squeeze some information out of us. We’re finally ready to show you one of the biggest choices you’re going to make in Frostpunk: [b]choosing the path for your people. Showing them purpose... even if you have to do it with an iron fist.[/b] 

[h1][b] --- ENDGAME MECHANICS REVEAL  --- [/b][/h1]

[code][h1][i]"What makes you a good leader? Or to put it differently - what makes you an effective leader? If you're democratically elected one in some modern country, or if you rule a city in a video game about last bits of civilization trying to survive on a frozen Earth, the rules stay the same" - says Aleksander Kauch, lead gameplay programmer of Frostpunk. "You can try to be the noble one and listen to the people, no matter if they're right or wrong, or you can believe that your cold-blooded calculations will prove valid over the course of survival. Introducing Neighbourhood Watch Law can be the answer to the need of safety on the streets... unless you deem it insufficient and decide to send guards to detain rioters with bats. From a watchful overseer to the rigorous visionary that puts the higher cause over decency - that will be your choice as a player."[/i][/h1][/code]

See the newly unveiled endgame mechanics and features in the [b]“Irreversible” Developer Update video[/b]:
https://youtu.be/pFId6lm2MZo

[h1][b] --- GAMEPLAY DETAILS --- [/b][/h1]

Choosing the path of Order will deeply impact your society - and for you as a leader it means a whole [b]new range of tools available at your disposal[/b]. We want you to discover them when you play the game but let us show you some examples of new laws that will become accessible after you choose to pursue the path of Order.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wJg07kpiH3jiSd00rj/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Neighbourhood Watch[/u][/b]
We need to mobilise and stand together to help people in need and protect them from troublemakers.

Neighbourhood Watch allows you to construct a brand [b]new building[/b]: Watchtower. People living nearby Watchtowers are protected by their neighbours serving as watch members and feel a lot safer. This gives them hope.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Rd9hAxVpmvj2zw8hAE/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Guard Stations[/u][/b]
Organised militia will guard the peace and order in our city and help us deal with anyone who would threaten it.

This law allows you to establish a [b]Guard Station[/b]. Guard Stations bring peace and order to nearby homes. The presence of guards lowers the discontent and restores hope.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BGG2vGYYHM2VdFqBpW/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Patrol[/u][/b]
Ensuring safety and order is of utmost priority to the long term survival of our city.

This law won’t unlock any new buildings - but it gives you an active [b]Patrol ability[/b] to use. After enabling it, guards will patrol the streets near their guard stations to uphold law and order. You'll have to provide them with extra food for their effort.

These are just three basic laws that you can introduce after choosing the path of Order. More of them - in different form and magnitude - await you in the world of Frostpunk!

[h1][b] --- RELEASE DETAILS --- [/b][/h1]

We’ve already announced that we aim to set the price for Frostpunk to be on a “premium indie” level. What most of you assumed was €35-40... so you should be happy to hear that [b]Frostpunk’s digital version will be available for [u]$29,99/EUR 29,99[/u][/b] (or your regional equivalent)! We really want it to be as accessible as possible - so we hope you’re happy with this price! 

That’s not all! We have also finished the [b]box art for the game[/b]! It was created by one and only Jakub Kowalczyk - who was responsible for a lot of “This War of Mine” artworks as well. Jakub - busy as he is - was cool enough to share some insights about creating Frostpunk’s cover art:
[code][h1][i]“The biggest challenge here was to create an inclusive art that would show all aspects of the game: harsh and freezing weather, the generator that towers above the city, cross-section of the society and - of course - you as its leader. It not only had to work as an attractive illustration - but I had to make sure it’s still usable as box art - which means adjustability for different platforms etc. You never know where some additional pesky logos may appear...”[/i][/h1][/code]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/1be9599019272656528b2fde078e1f7106c6a398.png[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/FP_Cover_Art_FINAL_FLAT_2d_300DPI.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]What about the price of the retail version? What versions of the game are we preparing in general? Do we plan to release an art book? What about the release date?[/b] We’d love to answer all these questions now but we’re still discussing some final technicalities with distributors and whatnot. We will give you all the details in one of the future updates - stay tuned!

[h1][b] --- ADDITIONAL Q&A --- [/b][/h1]

[b]1. Do you plan to support controllers (Xbox/PS4/Steam Controller)?[/b]
Maybe in the future - but definitely not on day one.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/83d96af224066313caa40c6df5985c8713aae5d1.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_04.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]2. Are you going to do a surprise release or are you going to announce a release date some days in advance?[/b]
We plan to announce it beforehand. We just gave you the box art and the price so rejoice! We want to share more info about the release in one of the future updates, stay tuned.

[b]3. You started to show new things from the game: first the automatons, now the Order. Are you adding it to the game last minute?[/b]
Don't worry, we are not adding new stuff to the game at this point. Automatons are not something new, we didn't introduce them two weeks ago. We just didn't show them before! Same situation with the Order mechanics - they are not new by any means, we were just keeping them a secret. 

[b]4. Do you plan to make some kind of AMA in the future?[/b]
Yes, we would love to do that later on - when we have more information revealed already. In the meantime, we try to visit this discord channel created by our wonderful community: https://discord.gg/CukfhBG - we tend to answer some smaller questions there, so be sure to visit us from time to time!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/f9f31da7bb085e36c19d07a7059f1bf2c077d69c.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_01.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]5. One word: airships. Do you plan to include them in Frostpunk?[/b]
Well… you have already seen the Beacons that we have in game, right? Let’s just say that they are not the only flying objects in Frostpunk! However, remember that we try to depict our vision of steampunk - which is quite pragmatic and authentic. So don’t expect huge fleets of airships or something like that.

[b]6. Is there going to be a new preview demo for press/influencers anytime soon?[/b]
Nope. We focus on bringing the final game as soon as possible so the next build that we plan to distribute is going to be the full, review copy of Frostpunk.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/843ed253ec90ddf1edd258c7bbd283f6713a97ce.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_05.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]7. When do you plan to post next update?[/b]
We want to release it in few weeks at most. Again, the idea is to create substantial updates - and those take some time. However, in the meantime we’re going to share some cool screenshots (and GIFs?!) on our social channels - so be sure to follow us there:[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/frostpunkgame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/]Official website[/url][/list]
Have a good one and see you next time!

[h1][b] --- ENDGAME MECHANICS REVEAL  --- [/b][/h1]

[code][h1][i]"What makes you a good leader? Or to put it differently - what makes you an effective leader? If you're democratically elected one in some modern country, or if you rule a city in a video game about last bits of civilization trying to survive on a frozen Earth, the rules stay the same" - says Aleksander Kauch, lead gameplay programmer of Frostpunk. "You can try to be the noble one and listen to the people, no matter if they're right or wrong, or you can believe that your cold-blooded calculations will prove valid over the course of survival. Introducing Neighbourhood Watch Law can be the answer to the need of safety on the streets... unless you deem it insufficient and decide to send guards to detain rioters with bats. From a watchful overseer to the rigorous visionary that puts the higher cause over decency - that will be your choice as a player."[/i][/h1][/code]

See the newly unveiled endgame mechanics and features in the [b]“Irreversible” Developer Update video[/b]:
https://youtu.be/pFId6lm2MZo

[h1][b] --- GAMEPLAY DETAILS --- [/b][/h1]

Choosing the path of Order will deeply impact your society - and for you as a leader it means a whole [b]new range of tools available at your disposal[/b]. We want you to discover them when you play the game but let us show you some examples of new laws that will become accessible after you choose to pursue the path of Order.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wJg07kpiH3jiSd00rj/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Neighbourhood Watch[/u][/b]
We need to mobilise and stand together to help people in need and protect them from troublemakers.

Neighbourhood Watch allows you to construct a brand [b]new building[/b]: Watchtower. People living nearby Watchtowers are protected by their neighbours serving as watch members and feel a lot safer. This gives them hope.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Rd9hAxVpmvj2zw8hAE/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Guard Stations[/u][/b]
Organised militia will guard the peace and order in our city and help us deal with anyone who would threaten it.

This law allows you to establish a [b]Guard Station[/b]. Guard Stations bring peace and order to nearby homes. The presence of guards lowers the discontent and restores hope.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BGG2vGYYHM2VdFqBpW/giphy.gif[/img]
[b][u]Law: Patrol[/u][/b]
Ensuring safety and order is of utmost priority to the long term survival of our city.

This law won’t unlock any new buildings - but it gives you an active [b]Patrol ability[/b] to use. After enabling it, guards will patrol the streets near their guard stations to uphold law and order. You'll have to provide them with extra food for their effort.

These are just three basic laws that you can introduce after choosing the path of Order. More of them - in different form and magnitude - await you in the world of Frostpunk!

[h1][b] --- RELEASE DETAILS --- [/b][/h1]

We’ve already announced that we aim to set the price for Frostpunk to be on a “premium indie” level. What most of you assumed was €35-40... so you should be happy to hear that [b]Frostpunk’s digital version will be available for [u]$29,99/EUR 29,99[/u][/b] (or your regional equivalent)! We really want it to be as accessible as possible - so we hope you’re happy with this price! 

That’s not all! We have also finished the [b]box art for the game[/b]! It was created by one and only Jakub Kowalczyk - who was responsible for a lot of “This War of Mine” artworks as well. Jakub - busy as he is - was cool enough to share some insights about creating Frostpunk’s cover art:
[code][h1][i]“The biggest challenge here was to create an inclusive art that would show all aspects of the game: harsh and freezing weather, the generator that towers above the city, cross-section of the society and - of course - you as its leader. It not only had to work as an attractive illustration - but I had to make sure it’s still usable as box art - which means adjustability for different platforms etc. You never know where some additional pesky logos may appear...”[/i][/h1][/code]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/1be9599019272656528b2fde078e1f7106c6a398.png[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/FP_Cover_Art_FINAL_FLAT_2d_300DPI.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]What about the price of the retail version? What versions of the game are we preparing in general? Do we plan to release an art book? What about the release date?[/b] We’d love to answer all these questions now but we’re still discussing some final technicalities with distributors and whatnot. We will give you all the details in one of the future updates - stay tuned!

[h1][b] --- ADDITIONAL Q&A --- [/b][/h1]

[b]1. Do you plan to support controllers (Xbox/PS4/Steam Controller)?[/b]
Maybe in the future - but definitely not on day one.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/83d96af224066313caa40c6df5985c8713aae5d1.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_04.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]2. Are you going to do a surprise release or are you going to announce a release date some days in advance?[/b]
We plan to announce it beforehand. We just gave you the box art and the price so rejoice! We want to share more info about the release in one of the future updates, stay tuned.

[b]3. You started to show new things from the game: first the automatons, now the Order. Are you adding it to the game last minute?[/b]
Don't worry, we are not adding new stuff to the game at this point. Automatons are not something new, we didn't introduce them two weeks ago. We just didn't show them before! Same situation with the Order mechanics - they are not new by any means, we were just keeping them a secret. 

[b]4. Do you plan to make some kind of AMA in the future?[/b]
Yes, we would love to do that later on - when we have more information revealed already. In the meantime, we try to visit this discord channel created by our wonderful community: https://discord.gg/CukfhBG - we tend to answer some smaller questions there, so be sure to visit us from time to time!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/f9f31da7bb085e36c19d07a7059f1bf2c077d69c.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_01.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]5. One word: airships. Do you plan to include them in Frostpunk?[/b]
Well… you have already seen the Beacons that we have in game, right? Let’s just say that they are not the only flying objects in Frostpunk! However, remember that we try to depict our vision of steampunk - which is quite pragmatic and authentic. So don’t expect huge fleets of airships or something like that.

[b]6. Is there going to be a new preview demo for press/influencers anytime soon?[/b]
Nope. We focus on bringing the final game as soon as possible so the next build that we plan to distribute is going to be the full, review copy of Frostpunk.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/843ed253ec90ddf1edd258c7bbd283f6713a97ce.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Order_05.jpg][i]Click here for high resolution[/i][/url]

[b]7. When do you plan to post next update?[/b]
We want to release it in few weeks at most. Again, the idea is to create substantial updates - and those take some time. However, in the meantime we’re going to share some cool screenshots (and GIFs?!) on our social channels - so be sure to follow us there:[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/frostpunkgame]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/frostpunkgame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=http://www.frostpunkgame.com/]Official website[/url][/list]
Have a good one and see you next time!
